Victor Wembanyama delivered a historic performance for the San Antonio Spurs, finishing with an incredible 52 points on 16-of-28 shooting, 24 rebounds, and 8 blocks. With this achievement, Wembanyama became just the second player in NBA history, joining Bob McAdoo, to record at least 50 points, 20 rebounds, and 5 blocks in a single game since blocks became an official statistic in 1973-74.
